# Nanonets

Nanonets provides an AI-driven Intelligent Document Processing API that transforms unstructured documents into structured data, enabling efficient data extraction and workflow automation.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/nano-nets/.

## Actions

- **Create OCR Model**: Create a new ocr model.
- **Delete OCR Model**: Delete an ocr model.
- **Get all OCR models** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all ocr models.
- **Get All Prediction Files** (read-only): Fetch all prediction files associated with a specific model.
- **Get OCR Model Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of an ocr model.
- **Get OCR Training Images** (read-only): Retrieve training images for an ocr model.
- **Get Workflows** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all workflows in your nanonets account.
- **List Workflow Documents** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of documents processed by a workflow.
- **Update OCR Model**: Update an ocr model's details.
- **Upload Training Images by File**: Upload training images by file to a specified ocr model.
- **Upload Training Images by URL**: Upload training images by url to a specified ocr model.
